description: The admin reads the remote cluster's kubeconfig, reduced to its one context.

response.body:
apiVersion: v1
clusters:
- cluster:
    certificate-authority-data: <certificate-authority-data>
    server: <server:cluster-b>
  name: training-platform
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: training-platform
    user: remote-access
  name: training-platform
current-context: training-platform
kind: Config
users:
- name: remote-access
  user:
    token: <token>
